title: HEIGHT REGULATIONS FOR BUILDINGS, SIGNS OR STRUCTURES
previewText: Notwithstanding any other provisions of this Resolution, no portion of any building or other structure hereafter constructed, or of any sign hereafter erected, or of any existing building or other structure hereafter relocated, enlarged or reconstructed, shall penetrate a view plane unless authorized by the City Planning Commission, pursuant to Section 102-30 (SPECIAL PERMIT PROVISIONS).
